info.name: Reports SAWT Attachments
info.description:
# Reports SAWT Attachments

Upload filled SAWT workbooks (or supporting files) to VM4 and retrieve them alongside the computed SAWT alphalist.

## Prerequisite
Run `sawt_report_attachment.sql` on the **master** database before uploading.

## Auth
- Header: `API-KEY` (required)
- Body/query: `token`, `requester` (required)

## Period keys
Attachments are linked by exact match on:
- `date_from` (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `date_to` (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `branch_id` (optional — omit or leave empty for all branches; allowed: 1 mobile, 2 oakridge, 3 mactan, 4 consolacion, 7 mantlewood)

## Workflow
1. **POST** `/reports/upload_sawt_report_attachment` — upload one file per request (repeat for multiple files)
2. **GET** `/reports/sawt_report` — same period keys; response includes `attachments[]` with uploaded files

formdata.description: Optional. Leave empty for all branches. Allowed: 1, 2, 3, 4, 7
SAWT file — uploaded to VM4 (pdf, png, jpeg, jpg, xls, xlsx, csv; max 5 MB). Set type to File in Postman.

request.description:
## POST `/reports/upload_sawt_report_attachment`

Uploads one SAWT attachment to VM4 and saves metadata in `sawt_report_attachment` on master DB.

### Required form fields
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `token` | text | Auth token |
| `requester` | text | User id |
| `date_from` | text | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `date_to` | text | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `attachment` | **file** | Single file per request |

### Optional form fields
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `branch_id` | text | 1 mobile, 2 oakridge, 3 mactan, 4 consolacion, 7 mantlewood. Omit for all branches |

### File rules
- Allowed extensions: `pdf`, `png`, `jpeg`, `jpg`, `xls`, `xlsx`, `csv`
- Max size: 5 MB
- VM4 storage path: `assets/sawt_reports/{date_from}_{date_to}/{branch_id|all}/`

### Postman setup
1. Body type: **form-data** (not raw JSON)
2. Set `attachment` row type to **File**, then **Select Files**
3. Do not set `Content-Type` manually — Postman adds the multipart boundary

### Multiple files
Call this endpoint once per file using the same `date_from`, `date_to`, and `branch_id`.

### Success response
```json
{
  "sawt_report_attachment_id": 1,
  "file_url": "https://file.myt-emr.com/assets/sawt_reports/2026-06-01_2026-06-30/all/...",
  "message": "SAWT report attachment uploaded successfully."
}
```

### Error responses
- Missing or invalid file: `attachment file is required and must be valid.`
- Bad extension: `Invalid file type. Allowed: pdf, png, jpeg, jpg, xls, xlsx, csv.`
- Over 5 MB: `File exceeds 5 MB limit.`
- VM4 failure: `Upload failed: ...`

query.description: Optional. Must match upload period keys exactly.
Optional filter on Vendor_TIN, companyName, surName

request.description:
## GET `/reports/sawt_report`

Returns computed SAWT alphalist rows (HMO/CORP/YAKAP withholding) plus uploaded attachments for the same reporting period.

### Query params
| Param | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `token` | yes | Auth token |
| `requester` | yes | User id |
| `date_from` | yes | YYYY-MM-DD — must match upload |
| `date_to` | yes | YYYY-MM-DD — must match upload |
| `branch_id` | no | Must match upload exactly (omit on both for all branches) |
| `term` | no | Filter rows by Vendor_TIN, companyName, or surName |

### Success response
```json
{
  "date_from": "2026-06-01",
  "date_to": "2026-06-30",
  "branch_id": null,
  "size": 12,
  "data": [
    {
      "Reporting_Month": "2026-06-15",
      "Vendor_TIN": "123456789012",
      "branchCode": "00000",
      "companyName": "Sample HMO Corp",
      "surName": "",
      "firstName": "",
      "middleName": "",
      "ATC": "WC020",
      "income_payment": 10000.00,
      "ewt_rate": 2.00,
      "tax_amount": 200.00
    }
  ],
  "attachments": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "file_name": "SAWT_June.xls",
      "file_url": "https://file.myt-emr.com/assets/sawt_reports/2026-06-01_2026-06-30/all/SAWT_June.xls",
      "mime": "application/vnd.ms-excel",
      "added_on": "2026-08-27 10:00:00"
    }
  ]
}
```

### 404 rule
Returns 404 only when **both** `data` and `attachments` are empty.
